name: University of Alberta
summary: Edmonton university opened in 1908: 37,735 undergraduates, 17 faculties on five campuses and more than 200 undergraduate program options.

ib.text: Six IB courses, five of them the subjects your program requires, no grade below 4. Past competitive diplomas ran from 30 to 37 points depending on program; IB grades are converted to percentages.

dates.label: Apply for North Campus residence by this date for a guaranteed spot
Deadline for high school students to submit outstanding documents

programmes.name: Computing Science
programmes.about: A customizable Science degree with strengths in artificial intelligence, machine learning, robotics, games and databases, as a major or honors, with a minor or double major from more than 60 subjects.
programmes.ib: English, Maths and two sciences; Maths AA (HL or SL) gives the Calculus the first-year courses need, AI HL counts as Maths 30-1 only.

needs.note: Calculus is needed to register; only Maths AA gives it

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the five required subjects converted to percentages; no grade below 4. Competitive diplomas have run 30 to 37 points by program. Apply early.

flagshipSource.title: U of A's AI strength: Amii partnership, 24 Canada CIFAR AI Chairs including Turing Award winner Richard Sutton

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: Direct entry from school into a general first-year program, after which you apply to your specialization. Five departments: Biomedical, Mechanical, Electrical and Computer, Chemical and Materials, Civil and Environmental; co-op is available.
programmes.ib: English, Chemistry, Physics, Calculus (so Maths AA) and Maths are required; Maths AI HL counts as Maths 30-1 only, AI SL as Maths 30-2.

needs.note: Calculus is a separate requirement; AA gives it

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the five required subjects converted to percentages; meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission, and engineering is competitive.

flagshipSource.title: Faculty of Engineering: general first year, five departments, co-op and accredited programs

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: English, Chemistry, Physics, Calculus and Maths; one general first year, then you apply to a specialization.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: English, Maths, two of Biology, Calculus, Chemistry or Physics and one more subject; specializations may add prerequisites.

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: English plus four subjects across humanities, fine arts and sciences (one fine art); a broad range is encouraged.

faculties.name: Faculty of Agricultural, Life & Environmental Sciences
faculties.line: English, Biology, Chemistry and Maths for most direct-entry degrees, plus one more subject.

faculties.name: Faculty of Nursing
faculties.line: English, Biology, Chemistry, Maths or Calculus and one more subject; spoken English proficiency is also required.

faculties.name: Faculty of Kinesiology, Sport, and Recreation
faculties.line: English plus humanities, science and maths subjects; Biology is recommended for the recreation, sport and tourism degree.

notes: Alberta's international tuition rises 5.5% for new students in Fall 2027 (approved March 2026), and 26% for Computing Science; the guarantee then fixes it for the program.
Applications are made to a faculty and program; the application fee is CAD 150 for new applicants.
Final IB results transcript must reach the university by 1 August.
